For [path](/docs/shell/commands/categories/path/).

<div class='command-title'>Get the type of the object a path refers to (e.g., file, dir, symlink).</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> path type {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input        | output       |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| string       | string       |
| list&lt;string&gt; | list&lt;string&gt; |
## Examples

Show type of a filepath.
```nu
> '.' | path type
dir
```

Empty string is not a path.
```nu
> '' | path type | is-empty
true
```

Show type of filepaths in a list.
```nu
> ls | get name | path type

```

## Notes
This checks the file system to confirm the path's object type.
If the path does not exist, null will be returned.
